subject: Neighborhood Recommendations Needed
body:
Hey John,

I hope this message finds you well! I'm reaching out because I'm considering a move to your area, and I could really use some advice on good neighborhoods. I'm looking for a place that's safe, family-friendly, and has a nice community vibe. I know you've been living there for a while, so I figured you'd be the perfect person to ask. Any recommendations you could provide would be greatly appreciated!

Best,
Sarah
